the prevalence of disability in Korean older adults increased with age, was higher in females, and was associated with lower educational level and lower income.

the prevalence of disability in the elderly population is increasing and that this increase is due to the increase in the proportion of people with combined lifestyle risks, such as smoking, alcohol consumption and obesity.
the prevalence of combined lifestyle risks was high among Korean older adults and that combined lifestyle risks were significantly associated with the disability transition in older Korean adults.

the relationship between the social determinants and health status of older adults in Korea.
the impact of social capital on health.
the effects of the social and cultural context on health and health-related behaviours in the older population.

there is a strong and positive correlation between the number of lifestyle risks and disability in older adults.
the current evidence suggests that the risk of disability increases with the number of combined lifestyle risks.

the results of this study suggest that there is an association between the combined lifestyle risks of smoking, alcohol consumption, physical inactivity, and unhealthy diet, and disability in older adults, and that this association is stronger in men.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there is an association between lifestyle risk factors and the transition from disability to no disability, which is stronger in older adults with higher levels of disability at the baseline.
there are many different types of disability and that these are associated with different types of health and social factors.
the combination of smoking, physical inactivity, and obesity is a major contributor to disability among older adults, and this combination is associated with the risk of disability in older adults.

the combined lifestyle risks (i.e. smoking, alcohol consumption and physical inactivity) are associated with the transition of disability in older adults.
the disability transition has been occurring in Korea.
